description: Returns a proxy's credentials as ready-to-paste strings: http:// and socks5:// URLs, a host:port:login:password line that most proxy managers and browser-profile tools import, a curl command to test it, and for mobile proxies the change-IP link that such tools accept as a "change IP URL". For residential proxies the strings reflect the current geo settings, which set_residential_geo changes.
name: get_connection_string
title: Get ready-to-paste connection strings
